demonstrates: Built the coordination surface a dozen AI sessions use across several machines: an append-only, session-stamped trail with no update or delete grant, typed refusals at the write path for a mislabelled session, an empty closure, an uncommitted delivery claim and a session id one keystroke from a real one, and a read receipt that cannot be revoked.
